name: sunny-kestrel-provisional-transport-decision-g0
source_version: ASP.NET Core 10.x documentation; installed mod game-free tests net6.0; exact disposable test target/runtime unresolved

doc_sources.scope: Documents RequestHeadersTimeout, MaxConcurrentConnections, MaxRequestBodySize and minimum body/response data rates; not an absolute ingress deadline.
Documents explicit Listen(IPAddress.Loopback, port) versus localhost dual-stack and wildcard/host URL binding behavior; no port chosen here.
Documents header size/count and request line limits; not original byte-for-byte header provenance.
RawTarget is request target as sent without URL decoding; Headers aggregate by name, retaining distinct values across lines, not original header-name bytes.
Exposes connection ID and local/remote address; original peer provenance requires the chosen direct-binding topology.
Abort aborts underlying connection; RequestAborted is cancellation notification, not proof arbitrary application work has terminated.
Documents request abort notification and handling; bounded completion of all owned operations is still separate.
Previously reviewed four-transport source feasibility and NO-GO matrix, not Windows evidence.

field_rows.documented_interface_or_control: Kestrel Limits.RequestHeadersTimeout bounds receive-header duration; not a combined body lifetime.
field_rows.entry_review_needed: Confirm exact start/reference domain and handling of first request, keepalive and HTTP/1.1; pin target API version.
field_rows.mandatory_unknown_fallback: BLOCK if no enforceable total pre-handler resource bound

field_rows.documented_interface_or_control: No documented immutable first-byte/connection-to-handler clock including wait for all queued requests.
field_rows.entry_review_needed: Review feasible equivalent external prehandler bound plus independent clock evidence; application middleware timestamp is late.
field_rows.mandatory_unknown_fallback: BLOCK if first-byte-to-ingress or enforceable equivalent cannot be shown

field_rows.documented_interface_or_control: Minimum request-body data rate is not an 8s nonresetting first-byte-to-finished-ingress deadline.
field_rows.entry_review_needed: Specify immutable clock anchor and transport-owned abort, account header+body and queue, verify body trickle cannot renew.
field_rows.mandatory_unknown_fallback: BLOCK if total-body timing can be reset or started at middleware

field_rows.documented_interface_or_control: MaxConcurrentConnections counts concurrent TCP connections; this is not per-authenticated-principal or game P2 queue capacity.
field_rows.entry_review_needed: Propose finite connections, per-IP/unauth occupancy and reserved shutdown control independent from HTTP; rationale and isolated limits unratified.

field_rows.documented_interface_or_control: Server header total/count/request-line caps; application cannot inspect already rejected bytes.
field_rows.entry_review_needed: Propose finite headers, name/value and request line caps, include duplicate/conflicting header cases and kernel vs app rejection evidence.
field_rows.mandatory_unknown_fallback: BLOCK if harmful frames reach any protected candidate or cannot attribute rejection

field_rows.documented_interface_or_control: MaxRequestBodySize and minimum body rate are documented; neither by itself proves immutable whole ingress budget.
field_rows.entry_review_needed: Review 16383/16384/16385-byte variants plus trickle/EOF and actual application-owned read task completion; do not ratify values by JSON.
field_rows.mandatory_unknown_fallback: BLOCK on oversized alloc, unbounded read or unverified stop

field_rows.documented_interface_or_control: Connection limits alone do not establish all OS TCP/listen accept queue and waiting-request occupancy.
field_rows.entry_review_needed: Review OS/process accept-backlog, keepalive, HTTP/1.1 pipeline and middlewares; independent bounded overload strategy.
field_rows.mandatory_unknown_fallback: BLOCK if any pre-handler queue cannot be bounded safely

field_rows.documented_interface_or_control: IHttpRequestFeature.RawTarget is target as sent, without URL decoding, but is a mutable feature after parsing.
field_rows.entry_review_needed: Verify feature source before untrusted middleware, parser refusal handling, path transformation and per-connection attribution.
field_rows.mandatory_unknown_fallback: BLOCK when actual original target or routing differentiation cannot be proven

field_rows.documented_interface_or_control: IHttpRequestFeature.Headers groups by header name while retaining line values; original Host spelling, line whitespace/order and parser-discarded bytes not promised.
field_rows.entry_review_needed: Separate sent bytes, server parsed Host values, duplicate/contradictory Host denial and source of any kernel rejection.
field_rows.mandatory_unknown_fallback: BLOCK if security requires lost original Host-line bytes

field_rows.documented_interface_or_control: Parsed values do not establish original rejected Content-Length/Transfer-Encoding or malformed header line bytes.
field_rows.entry_review_needed: Design explicit client-send vs server reject evidence, no handler-candidate, interim responses and unknown-layer attribution.
field_rows.mandatory_unknown_fallback: BLOCK when denial cannot be attributed at required security boundary

field_rows.documented_interface_or_control: IHttpConnectionFeature exposes remote/local endpoint and ConnectionId; forwarded headers are client-supplied absent independently reviewed proxy topology.
field_rows.entry_review_needed: Require direct approved loopback-only binding and provenance of connection ID, reject forwarded claimed peer or untrusted Host.
field_rows.mandatory_unknown_fallback: BLOCK if identity/trusted peer derived from client headers

field_rows.documented_interface_or_control: HTTP/1.1 protocol, Expect:100-continue, OPTIONS preflight/cookies and response intermediates need per-layer evidence; no game/private routes.
field_rows.entry_review_needed: Future test variant must distinguish accepted 100 response, rejected form/preflight and no Authorization/Cookie echo.
field_rows.mandatory_unknown_fallback: BLOCK on private response or unverifiable interim effects

field_rows.documented_interface_or_control: Connection ID does not itself distinguish every request in a pipelined/keep-alive sequence.
field_rows.entry_review_needed: Keep synthetic request alias, sequence, trace clock domain and stage for each request; no owner inheritance.
field_rows.mandatory_unknown_fallback: BLOCK if one request contaminates the next

field_rows.documented_interface_or_control: HttpContext.Abort aborts underlying connection and RequestAborted signals cancellation; neither documents quiescence of arbitrary user work.
field_rows.entry_review_needed: Identify transport-owned abort mechanism, handler read completion and collateral per connection; no Task.WhenAny/408 proof.
field_rows.mandatory_unknown_fallback: BLOCK if read remains alive or abort scope unknown

field_rows.documented_interface_or_control: No built-in Kestrel request middleware is independent of saturated listener/application queues.
field_rows.entry_review_needed: Source-review a separately owned operator control and bounded kill fallback without invoking a live test or choosing a port.
field_rows.mandatory_unknown_fallback: BLOCK if control depends on listener, queue, writer or handler locks

field_rows.documented_interface_or_control: RequestAborted and connection Abort are notifications, not a terminal audit of read/write/callback tasks.
field_rows.entry_review_needed: Specify independent, per-request task ledger: response writers, pending body reads, callbacks and collateral all terminal/observed.
field_rows.mandatory_unknown_fallback: BLOCK if any task is still unobserved or late callbacks could touch buffers

field_rows.documented_interface_or_control: No ASP.NET API cited guarantees reclamation of application-owned pooled buffers and no late access after abort.
field_rows.entry_review_needed: Specify owner, buffer ID, last possible access, quarantine and terminal proof for all pending/collateral requests.
field_rows.mandatory_unknown_fallback: BLOCK; do not free/repurpose buffers or claim retirement

field_rows.documented_interface_or_control: App or process stop is not proof every request task/buffer safely completed.
field_rows.entry_review_needed: Fixed independent monotonic deadlines; finite escalation; QUARANTINED if no proof; manual rollback and new explicit restart approval.
field_rows.mandatory_unknown_fallback: BLOCK if stop times out, evidence writer fails or collaterals unknown

requirements.provenance: Client bytes attempted vs Kestrel parser outcome vs HttpContext/IHttpRequestFeature exposed values are distinct, request attributed. Any mandatory unobservable original wire stays BLOCK.
requirements.admission: No request may become a real Sunny/game/P1 effect; G1 future disposable variant is isolated, synthetic-only and must be independently approved.
requirements.prehandler: RequestHeadersTimeout, MaxConcurrentConnections and body-rate controls are partial; no trusted whole-ingress first-byte/queue deadline or complete preauth limits yet.
requirements.abort: RequestAborted/HttpContext.Abort never imply terminal task/buffer proof. Retain capacity and quarantine until all owners observed complete.
requirements.version: Do not assume Microsoft v10 API descriptions prove Windows/net6 behavior; decide runtime/build/protocol only after independent review.
requirements.g1_mapping: Rework the 37 HTTP.sys-specific cases as a separately reviewed Kestrel variant, never rewrite their not_run status or claim equivalent measured HTTP.sys outcomes.
requirements.stop: External operator-controlled finite stop, independent of Kestrel pipeline/evidence writer, with deadline, collateral invalidation, quarantine and manual restart.
requirements.decision_boundary: No G1 entry gate closes automatically; a reviewed G0 method and independently ratified numbers plus separate explicit operator consent would be needed.

next_design_review: Independently review field-level feasibility, candidate version parity and external stop/buffer ownership; if no safe design for a mandatory property, BLOCK this candidate and keep alternative comparison open.
